task: Provide an executive 2-line brief (maximum 40 words) on Voltaic Labs' battery progress. Do not write a full report.

results.title: Voltaic Labs -- Company Overview
results.snippet: Voltaic Labs is a battery startup founded in 2021, working on solid-state lithium-metal cells for grid storage.

results.title: Voltaic Labs -- Funding History
results.snippet: Voltaic Labs raised a Series B round led by Northwind Ventures in early 2023.

results.title: Voltaic Labs -- Leadership Team
results.snippet: The company was co-founded by Priya Anand (CEO) and Marcus Weil (CTO), both formerly of Halcyon Energy.

results.title: Voltaic Labs Unveils First Prototype (2022 press release)
results.snippet: Voltaic Labs announced a prototype cell reaching 320 Wh/kg energy density in lab conditions.

results.title: Voltaic Labs Reports Improved Cell Performance (2024 press release)
results.snippet: Voltaic Labs' latest generation cell reaches 410 Wh/kg, a 28% improvement over its 2022 prototype.

results.title: Voltaic Labs Community Forum -- Thread #88
results.snippet: A community discussion thread mentioning Voltaic Labs' roadmap and upcoming announcements.

result.content: Voltaic Labs' current-generation cell reaches 410 Wh/kg in lab conditions, a 28% improvement over the 320 Wh/kg figure from its 2022 prototype. This is the company's most recent published figure as of this writing; the 2022 number should be treated as outdated.

input.summary: Voltaic Labs, founded in 2021 by Priya Anand and Marcus Weil, has made significant progress in solid-state lithium-metal battery technology for grid-scale energy storage. Their most recent generation cell, announced in 2024, reaches 410 Wh/kg in lab conditions, representing a 28% improvement over their original 2022 prototype which achieved 320 Wh/kg. The company, which raised a $42M Series B round led by Northwind Ventures in 2023, continues to iterate on its solid-state cell chemistry. Source: https://wiki.example/voltaic-labs/press-2024
